candidates.description: Fish Audio Drama 3 text to speech, natively in ComfyUI: voice cloning, dialogue and inline cues on cards from 8 GB, plus a native Qwen3-ASR. Built with Fish Audio.
candidates.readme_excerpt: Run **[Fish Audio Drama 3](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3)**, a 35B text-to-speech model for voice cloning, dialogue and inline cues such as `[sighs]` or `[whispers]`, **natively in ComfyUI on cards from 8 GB**. 90% of the model is routed experts and each audio frame uses only 8 of the 256 in a layer, so the experts stay in system RAM and the GPU keeps a cache of the ones in use. The pack also brings a native **Qwen3-ASR** that writes a voice clip's transcript for you, and nodes to save a cloned voice and load it again. Built with Fish Audio. > [!NOTE] > **3× faster since 2026-10-17.** The pack's own CUDA kernels read the experts the cache misses straight from RAM while > the CPU computes others, and every layer replays as a CUDA graph: one RTX 3090 now speaks a 9 s line in 6.7 s instead > of 16.7 s, about twice as fast as real time, two GPUs take 2.8 s, and an 8 GB card keeps pace with real time. > Nothing new to install. [Numbers](#performance).

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# VoxLock **The best performing voice isolator there is.** VoxLock is an open-source voice isolation model: it keeps the caller's voice and removes the other voices in the room before speech-to-text hears them. Made for voice agents and phone calls: one input, the call audio, and it picks out the caller by itself. It streams on a CPU with 24 ms of algorithmic latency, and plugs into [Pipecat](#pipecat) and [LiveKit](#livekit) voice agents. **[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40727)** · **[Model on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/arbazsiddiqui/voxlock)** · **[Try it in your browser](https://huggingface.co/spaces/arbazsiddiqui/voxlock)** · **[Write-up](https://arbazsiddiqui.me/voxlock)**

candidates.readme_excerpt: # Alfred **A local-first voice assistant for Home Assistant. # VideoFree Studio

**English** · [中文](README_ZH.md)

Current version: `2.0.1`

Official website: [videofreestudio.com](https://videofreestudio.com)

**Turn fragmented local AI workflows into complete creative capabilities that people can use, developers can distribute, and agents can call reliably.**

VideoFree Studio is a local AI video creation workspace, capability gateway, and plugin platform. It uses ComfyUI as a generation engine without forcing users to work directly with complex node graphs, model paths, and disconnected workflow files. Models, workflows, parameter forms, prompt expertise, and supporting assets are packaged as installable plugins, while projects, categories, assets, and jobs are managed in one place.

People can create in the workspace, while external agents use the same plugin capabilities, project data, and local media through MCP or HTTP APIs.

## Why VideoFree Studio

### Local AI is powerful, but fragmented

Cloud products choose the model, parameters, and interaction flow for the user. Moving to local creation means facing an overwhelming number of models, workflows scattered across the web, hard-to-read ComfyUI graphs, missing custom nodes, incompatible versions, and model paths that differ from one installation to another.

VideoFree Studio does not replace ComfyUI. It adds a stable product layer on top of it. A tested workflow can be packaged with its input rules, parameters, compiler logic, UI, dependencies, and documentation. Users select a capability like they would in a regular creative application instead of learning its internal graph first.

### Every model speaks a different prompt language

Image, video, speech, and music models use different prompt formats, media roles, and parameter constraints. The same request may need a completely different execution prompt for each model.

A VideoFree Studio plugin can ship model-specific collaboration skills. Users describe the desired scene, motion, dialogue, or music in plain language; the collaboration flow asks for missing information, checks media relationships, and compiles the request into the format expected by the selected model. Model-specific knowledge stays inside the plugin instead of accumulating in the framework.

### Local files, prompts, and production notes quickly become unmanageable

ComfyUI executes workflows well, but it is not a complete video project manager. Images, clips, voices, music, intermediate files, scripts, prompts, references, and chat no

candidates.description: DRAMA-Eval is a comprehensive bilingual (English & Chinese) benchmark designed to evaluate context-aware, multi-turn, and multi-speaker speech generation systems.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
DRAMA-Eval: A Benchmark for Context-Aware, Multi-Turn, Multi-Speaker Speech Generation

## 📢 News - **[2026-11-07]** We have updated the Leaderboard with **5 new models**: MOSS-TTS-2.0 Preview, Ming-3.0-tts-tiny, Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B, Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Next, and Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B. Check out the detailed comparison on our [Demo Page](https://ASLP-lab.github.io/DRAMA-Eval-Demo)! **DRAMA-Eval** is a comprehensive bilingual (English & Chinese) benchmark designed to evaluate context-aware, multi-turn, and multi-speaker speech generation systems. By utilizing structured script contexts grounded in real-world audio, it offers a holistic evaluation framework covering objective, local, and global aspects of generation quality.
## 📖 Introduction Recent advances in speech generation are rapidly shifting toward context-aware, multi-turn, and multi-speaker synthesis. While these capabilities are in high demand for applications such as audiobook and audio drama production, evaluation methodologies have not kept pace with these advances. DRAMA-Eval bridges this fundamental gap by providing a unified evaluation protocol that seamlessly integrates: - **Objective Metrics**: Textual fidelity (WER/CER) and Speaker Consistency (WavLM-based Cosine Similarity). - **Local LALM Metrics (B-Level)**: Instruction Following (B1), Prosody & Fluency (B2), and Local Expressiveness (B3) via an LLM-as-a-Judge approach. - **Global LALM Metrics (C-Level)**: Interaction Naturalness (C1), Global Flow (C2), and Scene Immersion (C3) through macr

candidates.readme_excerpt:
Docs · CLI · API · Examples · Live demo (username/password: demouser) · Discord

Dagu

Dagu is a local-first workflow engine for operations and internal automation. It is open source and self-hostable: a single binary with a built-in Web UI, no external database or message broker, running on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Define [DAGs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directed_acyclic_graph) in a declarative YAML format. It natively supports shell commands, Docker containers, Kubernetes Jobs, remote commands via SSH, and more through Dagu Actions. Dagu turns existing scripts and runbooks into production workflows with scheduling, retries, human tasks, and run history. It runs where your data and credentials live: on-prem, air-gapped, edge, or cloud, and scales from a single node to a fleet of workers. **Highlights:** - Single binary installation. - Self-contained: no external DBMS or message broker required. - Runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows. - Declarative YAML format for defining DAGs. - Run existing shell commands, Docker containers, Kubernetes Jobs, and remote commands over SSH without modifications. - Compose reusable Sub-DAGs and run work in parallel with concurrency controls. - Schedule workflows with cron syntax, timezones, overlap policies, and catch-up windows. - Keep logs, run history, retries, notifications, and webhook triggers in one place. - Built-in MCP server for inspecting workflows and runs, maintaining Wiki pages, applying changes, and controlling runs. - Optional monitoring in Dagu Console: every server's runs and trends in one place, and an email when a workflow fails or a server stops reporting. Opt-in, outbound HTTPS only, metadata only. ## Quick Look For a quick look at how workflows are defined, see the examples.

**LocalAI** is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required. **A small core, not a bundle.** Each backend wraps a best-in-class engine (llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion, MLX...) in its own image, pulled only when a model needs it. You install nothing you don't use. - **Composable by design**: backends are separate and pulled on demand, so you install only what your model needs - **Open and extensible**: load any model, or build your own backend in any language against an open interface - **Drop-in API compatibility**: OpenAI, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs APIs across every backend - **Any model, any modality**: LLMs, vision, voice
